description: sigma_LO(p p > el- el+) vs m_slepton at 13 TeV -- the LIKE-FOR-LIKE LO denominator for the slepton NLO+NLL k-factor used by nlo_xsec.py (--process slepton without --sigma-lo-pb) and by scan_orchestrator.py assemble --nlo-renorm slepton.
process: p p > el- el+ (selectron_L pair, PDG 1000011 x -1000011), 2->2 INCLUSIVE (no ISR-jet requirement) -- the SAME single-flavour single-chirality state the HEPi reference file 13000_sleptons_1000011_-1000011_NNLL.json contains, so the ratio k = sigma_NNLL/sigma_LO is state-for-state like-for-like (the trap .claude/rules/statistics.md warns about).
model: MSSM_SLHA2, param card = mapyde SleptonBino.slha rendered per mass (MSLEP=m, MN1=m-2; the LSP mass is irrelevant for the s-channel Drell-Yan production sigma)
pdf: cteq6l1 (MadGraph-internal) -- deliberately the SAME LO PDF the scan's signal samples were generated with: k(m) = sigma_NNLL(PDF4LHC21)/sigma_LO(cteq6l1) is deliberately MIXED in PDF and order because that ratio IS the multiplicative correction mapping a cteq6l1-LO-normalized sample onto the NLO+NLL normalization ATLAS/RRR use.
generator: MG5_aMC 2.9.27 LO, nevents=2000, iseed=1, ebeam=6500+6500, use_syst=False (run card = mapyde default_LO.dat, keyed edits per prepare_native_slepton.render_runcard)
generated: 2026-07-04 (one-off reference run; regenerate with the recipe above if the mass grid must be extended)
mc_unc_note: MC integration errors ~0.25% (from the MadGraph 'Cross-section : x +- y pb' lines), negligible vs the ~few-% scale/PDF uncertainty of the NNLL numerator.
